newsitem.title: USA: Martek components in new formula.
newsitem.headline: Martek components in new formula.

text.p: Martek Biosciences Corp said Thursday Novartis Nutrition SA has introduced the first commercial formula for full-term infants containing Maratek's proprietary nutritional oils.

The company said the Novartis AG subsidiary introduced the formula Adapta PEG in Spain. Adapta PEG is a premium formula targeted to full-term infants who are small for their age. Novartis has been selling a pre-term infant formula containing Martek's oils, called Pre Adapta, in Spain since early January.
Infant formula products containing Martek's nutritional oils are now being marketed by three manufacturers in eight countries, the company noted.
"This first commercial introduction of a full-term formula with Martek's oils is a milestone event," said chief executive Henry Linsert Jr.

"This is the fifth introduction of a formula product containing Martek's DHA and ARA in 1997, and is a continuance of what the company believes will be a series of such introductions" in 1997 in various countries around the world.
